energy.regenClock: persistLastRegenAtUTC; apply offline elapsed whole intervals; carry remainder
energy.webBehavior: ad UI unavailable outside native; no fake grants; developer-only mocked reward adapter allowed

chefPower.formula: 100 + Σ(weight[upgradeId]*(level-1)) + Σ(equippedItem.powerScoreByRarity) [do not count temporary in-run abilities]
chefPower.interpretation: A UI guide, not a hidden damage multiplier or numerical level lock. All contributions are tied to real implemented item/upgrade effects.

realEffects.rare: each 4th REAL normal shot +1 damage; replaces uncommon threshold

realEffects.uncommon: real mouth width +3%; collision geometry changes
realEffects.rare: real mouth width +6% total; collision geometry changes

realEffects.uncommon: every 7th unique kill grants one non-proccing bonus normal oil next volley
realEffects.rare: every 5th unique kill grants one non-proccing bonus normal oil next volley; replaces uncommon threshold

equipment.effectSafety: Bonus attacks cannot re-trigger critical, bonus generation or pan chains; no infinite proc loops. Existing ability and permanent upgrade effects stack explicitly, not by replacing.
equipment.inventoryScope: Alpha04 uses slot progression + guaranteed crafting, no equipment inventory, random affixes, merge or loot-box inventory. Design for eventual item inventory without building it now.

dungeons.afterDailyLimit: repeatable with smaller fixed rewards; continue costing energy

level20.guaranteedMaterialRoute: level15 first-clear gives 18 parts + first materials dungeon win gives 10 parts + four full-reward dungeon wins give 72 parts = 100 total; uncommon spends 40, rare spends 60
level20.additionalUpgradeNeeded: a normal permanent upgrade can cover remaining ~4 power

softHardWallEconomyExamples.manualValidation: Numbers are targets, not actual measured SG; no hidden hard lock.

rewardAtomicity: Energy, first-clear tips, dungeon parts and completed-stage rewards are committed exactly once per runId.

saveMigration.newCampaignProgress: start at level1 (new 20-stage track), do not pretend older single chapter completion cleared 10 new levels

testBudget.npmTest: existing suite plus <= 12 targeted new assertions
testBudget.e2e: only menu/stage1/stage10 unlock/energy/dungeon/old save smoke checks
testBudget.sim: maximum 10 deterministic short runs total; no thousands of seeds or long reports unless explicitly requested
